english.note: For a concrete shortfall or gap in an amount, this is the all-purpose noun rather than the budget-specific 赤字.
Use this for a shortfall or missing amount, such as a staffing or funding gap.

examples.english: There is still a three-thousand-dollar deficit in this month’s income.
examples.traditional: 呢個月嘅收入仲有三千蚊缺口。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyut6 ge3 sau1 jap6 zung6 jau5 saam1 cin1 man1 kyut3 hau2

examples.english: This project is still short by three hundred thousand; the funding gap is quite big.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃仲爭三十萬，個資金缺口幾大。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 zaang1 saam1 sap6 maan6 go3 zi1 gam1 kyut3 hau2 gei2 daai6
